Inherited lipid metabolism disorder umbrella; additional organ damage varies substantially among its constituent syndromes.

Cutaneous disorder classified as an exanthem; no evidence of another affected organ.
Lipid storage disorder; neurodegeneration in most, hepatic storage/cholestasis common (hepatomegaly 7/13). Splenic/marrow deposits alone do not establish dysfunction.
Muscular dystrophy with defining cardiomyopathy; both skeletal and cardiac muscle disease are intrinsic.
Fluke infection umbrella; hepatic, pulmonary and intestinal sites depend on the parasite and are not shared across the group.

Inherited variation in cardiac atrioventricular conduction, measured by the PR interval.
Severe developmental epileptic encephalopathy; cleft palate 7/11, flexion contractures 6/11, clubfoot 5/11 and scoliosis 4/11 support oral and skeletal involvement.
Sulfate transport/metabolism defect causing skeletal dysplasia and joint contractures; cleft palate affects 8/12. Blue sclerae and ear shape changes do not establish damage.
Gestational trophoblastic malignancy arising in the ovary, a reproductive organ outside the axes; hormone secretion alone is not endocrine gland disease.
Aneurysms and early osteoarthritis define disease; abnormal skin scarring and striae are frequent (30-79%). Dural ectasia alone does not establish neurologic dysfunction.

Stones occupy the gallbladder or bile ducts, both included in the hepatic axis.
B-lymphoblast malignancy involving blood/marrow or lymphoid tissue; the lymphoma designation also requires the infectious_immune axis.
Defining anal atresia and urinary tract malformations. Normal ovaries and genital ambiguity do not establish endocrine disease; respiratory insufficiency alone lacks direct lung injury.
Benign breast ductal neoplasm; breast tissue is outside the 13 axes.
